parameters.content:
## 🎬 Daily AI Series Creator v4
### "The Vanishing Files" — Auto-Generated Mystery Series

**Runs daily at 4:00 PM Nepal Time (10:15 UTC).** Each day it:
1. ✅ Generates a new mystery episode script (AI)
2. ✅ Creates a voiceover with ElevenLabs (free 10k chars/mo)
3. ✅ Generates 4 cinematic scene images via Pollinations.ai (100% FREE, no key needed)
4. ✅ Assembles a 15–20 second video via Shotstack (free sandbox)
5. ✅ Sends you a **WhatsApp preview** — tap APPROVE / CANCEL
6. ✅ Auto-posts after 30 min with no reply
7. ✅ Posts to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Telegram, Discord
8. ✅ Logs everything to Google Sheets

### 15 Credentials to Create
| Credential Name | Node Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| OpenRouter API | HTTP Header Auth | `Authorization: Bearer sk-or-...` |
| Google Gemini API | HTTP Header Auth | `x-goog-api-key: AIza...` |
| ElevenLabs API | HTTP Header Auth | `xi-api-key: ...` |
| Google TTS API | HTTP Header Auth | `x-goog-api-key: AIza...` |
| Shotstack API | HTTP Header Auth | `x-api-key: ...` |
| Creatomate API | HTTP Header Auth | `Authorization: Bearer ...` |
| Google Drive account | Google Drive OAuth2 | OAuth2 flow |
| Google Sheets account | Google Sheets OAuth2 | OAuth2 flow |
| WhatsApp account | WhatsApp Cloud API | Meta token |
| Meta (Facebook) account | Facebook Graph API | Page token |
| YouTube account | YouTube OAuth2 | OAuth2 flow |
| Twitter account | Twitter OAuth2 | OAuth2 flow |
| LinkedIn account | LinkedIn OAuth2 | OAuth2 flow |
| Telegram account | Telegram Bot Token | Bot token |
| Discord Bot account | Discord Bot Token | Bot token |
| TikTok API | HTTP Header Auth | `Authorization: Bearer ...` |

### IDs to Replace in ⚙️ SET: Config
`YOUR_WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID` · `YOUR_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID` · `YOUR_INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_USER_ID`
`YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` · `YOUR_AUDIO_FOLDER_ID` · `YOUR_VIDEO_FOLDER_ID`
`YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID` · `YOUR_DISCORD_GUILD_ID` · `YOUR_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` · `YOUR_TIKTOK_OPEN_ID`

## 🎥 Free Video Generation Pipeline

### How the video is made (no cost!)
```
[AI Story] → [ElevenLabs Voice] → [Pollinations Images] → [Shotstack Video]
```

| Step | Tool | Free Tier | Signup |
|---|---|---|---|
| Script | OpenRouter (Gemini 2.5 Pro) | Unlimited free | openrouter.ai |
| Script backup | Google Gemini Flash | 1500 req/day | aistudio.google.com |
| Voice | ElevenLabs | 10,000 chars/month | elevenlabs.io |
| Voice backup | Google Cloud TTS | 1M chars/month | cloud.google.com |
| Images | Pollinations.ai | ♾️ TRULY FREE (no key!) | pollinations.ai |
| Video assembly | Shotstack | Free sandbox (watermark) | shotstack.io |
| Video backup | Creatomate | 30 renders trial | creatomate.com |

### Pollinations.ai — No Setup Required!
Images are generated by calling:
`https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{encoded_prompt}?width=1080&height=1920&model=flux&enhance=true&nologo=true&seed={N}`

Shotstack then fetches these URLs directly when rendering. Zero downloads needed!

### Making Videos Look Realistic
All scene prompts include:
> `ultra realistic photography, Canon EOS R5, 4K RAW, cinematic, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, no CGI, no text`

Combined with Ken Burns zoom effects and fade transitions, the result looks like real cinematic footage.

## 📖 Series: The Vanishing Files

**Genre**: Supernatural mystery thriller
**Setting**: Mirefall — a foggy mountain town where people vanish
**Protagonist**: Detective Aria, haunted by her own mysterious past
**Format**: 15–20 second daily episodes with cliffhanger endings

### Episode Structure
```
[0–4s]  Scene 1  +  Episode title card
[4–8s]  Scene 2  (rising tension)
[8–12s] Scene 3  (mystery deepens)
[12–16s] Scene 4  +  CLIFFHANGER text
[Audio] Voiceover narration (40–55 words) throughout
```

### Why Viewers Keep Watching
- Each episode ends mid-revelation
- Cliffhanger text on screen: *"But what she found next..."*
- Next episode picks up exactly where it left off
- Series title + episode number = brand recognition

### Google Sheets — VanishingFiles Sheet
Create a sheet named **VanishingFiles** with these column headers in Row 1:
```
Episode | Title | VideoURL | AudioURL | Cliffhanger | PostedAt | Status
```

## ⏰ Schedule: 4:00 PM Nepal Time Daily

Nepal Standard Time = UTC+5:45
4:00 PM NPT = **10:15 AM UTC**

Cron: `15 10 * * *`

## 📲 WhatsApp Approval Flow
1. Bot sends you: preview URL + APPROVE link + CANCEL link
2. Tap APPROVE → posts immediately
3. Tap CANCEL → workflow stops
4. **No reply within 30 min** → auto-posts

## ⚠️ n8n Must Be Public HTTPS
Approval links use `$execution.resumeUrl`.
Your n8n instance must be at a public HTTPS URL.
- n8n.cloud: ✅ works out of the box
- Self-hosted: use ngrok or reverse proxy with SSL
- Set `N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL=https://your-domain.com`
